reports.title: Docs Index Table
reports.description: Displays a sortable Docs Viewer index table for a selected docs scope.

presets.title: Scope Documents Admin
presets.description: Management report for reviewing a publish-capable scope by title, doc_id, and publishability.

reports.title: Reports List
reports.description: Displays the configured Docs Viewer report metadata from the report registry.

reports.title: Docs Sub-Scope
reports.description: Displays a report-owned list over a configured Docs Viewer sub-scope.

reports.title: Source Config
reports.description: Displays Docs Viewer source config for all scopes in manage mode.

reports.title: Docs Broken Links
reports.description: Runs the Docs Viewer broken-links audit for a selected scope.

reports.title: Semantic Tokens
reports.description: Lists resolved semantic-token occurrences for a selected docs scope.

reports.title: Project State
reports.description: Reconciles immediate project folders with canonical Works, Series, and Project documents.

reports.title: Works
reports.description: Shows documentation coverage for every published Series.

reports.title: Catalogue Works
reports.description: Searches every published canonical Work with exact Series and storage context.

reports.title: Uncataloged Files
reports.description: Lists ordinary files in represented Work source folders that are not canonical Work primary sources.

reports.title: Missing Source Files
reports.description: Lists canonical Works whose complete expected source path does not resolve to a file.
